result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, a discover opener causes the server Peer to call require_request_metadata before ordinary serving. For any subsequent non-Initialize request, ServerHandler::handle_request treats request metadata as required because context.peer.request_metadata_required() is true, validates _meta against ProtocolVersion::V_2026_07_28 before method dispatch, and returns INVALID_PARAMS when missing_required_keys is nonempty. The required 2026-07-28 keys are io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion and io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities; clientInfo is optional. Thus the first ordinary post-discover request is rejected exactly when either required key is absent or malformed. A direct/session path that did not set the peer flag may omit per-request metadata unless the request itself is discover or declares protocolVersion 2026-07-28+ in its own _meta.
